carousel.subject: Sports & Games GK

questions.q: Cricket team mein kitne khiladi hote hain?
questions.why: Cricket team mein total 11 khiladi hote hain, ek time par field par.

questions.q: Olympic Games kitne saal baad hote hain?
questions.why: Olympic Games har 4 saal baad yaani once every four years organize hote hain.

questions.q: 'Hockey ka Jadugar' kise kaha jata hai?
questions.why: Major Dhyan Chand ko unki hockey skills ke kaaran 'Hockey ka Jadugar' kaha jata hai.

questions.q: Chess board mein kitne squares (ghar) hote hain?
questions.why: Chess board 8x8 ka grid hota hai, yaani total 64 squares (ghar) hote hain.

questions.q: Wimbledon tournament kis khel se sambandhit hai?
questions.why: Wimbledon duniya ka sabse purana aur prestigious Tennis tournament hai, England mein hota hai.
